subject: Insurer-direct-billing v0.2: sanctioned integration feasibility and adapter architecture
summary: Current evidence supports a provider-mediated claims-rail architecture. Pacific Blue Cross explicitly supports API integration for registered PROVIDERnet users and is the strongest bounded BC pilot candidate found. TELUS eClaims exposes the broadest multi-insurer vendor integration surface, but public evidence reviewed does not establish a direct consumer eClaims API for BenefitFlow. GreenShield/providerConnect supports provider eligibility and real-time adjudication, but a sanctioned machine interface remains unproven. Jane confirms provider-authorized integration semantics while also showing that PMS availability does not imply BenefitFlow access. Recommend no live claim or eligibility transaction code until partnership/API authorization exists; build adapter capability and authorization schemas first.
recommended_disposition: SUPPORTED: Pacific Blue Cross as a bounded API pilot candidate
SUPPORTED: TELUS eClaims as the highest-leverage multi-insurer partner surface
CONTRADICTED: generic consumer-side direct-billing API abstraction
INSUFFICIENT: direct BenefitFlow API access to TELUS, GreenShield/providerConnect, or Sun Life from public evidence
ESCALATE_TO_PRIMARY: begin Pacific Blue Cross and TELUS partner/API discovery before building live transaction code
